tgm50-wifi-ep.name: Electric Heating Thermostat
tgm50-wifi-ep.description: TGM50 thermostat is suitable for water heating, electric heating and boiler. The TGM50-EP model is listed for electric heating appliances with 16A current loading and week program. The manual lists WiFi for Android and Apple iOS, full-screen display and touchscreen, power-off memory function, real-time data save function, 5+2/6+1/7-day six-period program schedule, anti-freezing function, three sensor modes and child lock function.
keyFeatures: WiFi for Android and Apple iOS

tgm50-wifi-wp.name: Water Heating Thermostat
tgm50-wifi-wp.description: TGM50 thermostat is suitable for water heating, electric heating and boiler. The TGM50-WP model is listed for water heating appliances with 3A current loading and week program. The manual lists WiFi for Android and Apple iOS, full-screen display and touchscreen, power-off memory function, real-time data save function, 5+2/6+1/7-day six-period program schedule, anti-freezing function, three sensor modes and child lock function.
keyFeatures: WiFi for Android and Apple iOS
technicalData: current load: <=3A for water heating/gas boiler

tgm50b-wifi-ep.name: Electric Heating Thermostat
tgm50b-wifi-ep.description: The TGM50B WiFi thermostat product family includes electric floor heating, water floor heating and gas boiler heating versions. The model spec lists TGM50B-WIFI-EP with AC100-240V, 16A, electric floor heating, app control, air sensor and floor sensor. The product page says TGM50 series WiFi Thermostat works with Tuya app and Smart Life app, allowing phone control anywhere and anytime.
keyFeatures: GoogleHome / Amazon Alexa / Yandex Alice voice control for WiFi version
technicalData: load current: 16A for electric heating version

tgm50b-wifi-wp.name: Water Heating Thermostat
tgm50b-wifi-wp.description: TGM50B-WIFI-WP is described as a water floor heating thermostat. The product page states it is for water floor control, AC100-240V supply, 3A load current, only internal air sensor, wired connection, daily programmable, Wi-Fi enabled, with Tuya / Smart Life app control and GoogleHome / Amazon Alexa / Yandex Alice voice control for the WiFi version.
keyFeatures: voice control via GoogleHome / Amazon Alexa / Yandex Alice for WiFi version

tcc31-wifi-ep.name: Electric Heating Thermostat
tcc31-wifi-ep.description: TCC31 is a smart knob thermostat. The manual states the product type EP is suitable for electric floor heating. It has a protection class IP20, NTC3950 10K sensor, ±1°C accuracy, 5-95°C set temperature range and 100-240VAC power supply. The manual describes mode switching between manual and automatic modes, child lock, temperature setting by rotating the knob, advanced settings and Wi-Fi connection.
keyFeatures: EP suitable for electric floor heating
technicalData: current load: 3A for water heating/gas boiler, max 16A for electric heating

tcc31-wifi-wp.name: Water Heating Thermostat
tcc31-wifi-wp.description: TCC31 is a smart knob thermostat. The manual states the product type WP is suitable for water heating. The thermostat supports manual and automatic modes, child lock, knob-based temperature adjustment, advanced settings and Wi-Fi connection.
technicalData: current load: 3A for water heating/gas boiler, max 16A for electric heating

tgr85-wifi-wpb.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
tgr85-wifi-wpb.description: TGR85 thermostat is suitable for water heating, electric heating and boiler. The TGR85-WPB model is listed for boilers connected via dry contact with 3A current loading and week program. Main functions include WiFi for Android and Apple iOS, large screen display and touch button, power-off memory, real-time data save function, 5+2/6+1/7-day six-period program schedule, anti-freezing function, three sensor modes and child lock function.
keyFeatures: WiFi for Android and Apple iOS
large screen display and touch button
for boilers connected via dry contact.
technicalData: current load: <=3A for water heating/gas boiler, <=16A for electric heating

tgr85-wifi-ep.name: Electric Floor Heating Thermostat
tgr85-wifi-ep.description: TGR85-WIFI-EP is the electric floor-heating variant in the TGR85 series. It supports WiFi app control, a weekly programmable schedule, anti-freeze protection, child lock, and power-off memory with real-time data retention.
keyFeatures: WiFi control for Android and iOS

tcc31-wifi-wpb.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
tcc31-wifi-wpb.description: TCC31 is a smart knob thermostat. The manual states the product type WPB is suitable for gas boiler heating. It supports manual and automatic modes, child lock, knob-based temperature adjustment, advanced settings and Wi-Fi connection.
keyFeatures: WPB suitable for gas boiler heating
technicalData: current load: 3A for water heating/gas boiler, max 16A for electric heating

bot-r7w-x-wifi.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
bot-r7w-x-wifi.description: The BOT-R7X wireless gas boiler heating thermostat manual describes an intelligent digital thermostat used as a temperature controller. It compares ambient temperature and set temperature and controls the working state of the electric valve of the floor heating system to adjust ambient temperature. The WiFi manual includes WiFi connection and an electrical specification with NTC temperature sensor, +0.5°C temperature precision, <170uW self-consumption, 3pcs 1.5V batteries, 3A load current and IP20 protection grade.
technicalData: K1/K2 passive linkage of wall-hung furnaces
normally open/normally close motorized valve notes.

bot-r7b-x-wifi.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
bot-r7b-x-wifi.description: The BOT-R7X wireless gas boiler heating thermostat manual describes an intelligent digital thermostat used as a temperature controller. It compares ambient temperature and set temperature and controls the working state of the electric valve of the floor heating system to adjust ambient temperature. The WiFi manual includes WiFi connection and an electrical specification with NTC temperature sensor, +0.5°C temperature precision, <170uW self-consumption, 3pcs 1.5V batteries, 3A load current and IP20 protection grade.
technicalData: K1/K2 passive linkage of wall-hung furnaces
normally open/normally close motorized valve notes.

bot-r8x-wifi.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
bot-r8x-wifi.description: The BOT-R5X/R8X WiFi wireless boiler thermostat manual describes a wireless intelligent one-to-one digital thermostat for underfloor heating systems. It compares ambient temperature with set temperature and controls the working status of the gas wall mounted boiler and electric valve in the underfloor heating system to regulate ambient temperature for comfort and energy conservation.
keyFeatures: Tuya Smart / Smart Life network connection on 2.4 GHz WiFi
technicalData: Equipment power supply: 3x1.5V alkaline AAA batteries
WiFi setup via Tuya Smart/Smart Life and 2.4GHz WiFi.

trv-604.name: Thermostatic Radiator Valve
trv-604.description: TRV604 is a Wi-Fi smart thermostatic radiator valve. The manual states automatic debugging function suitable for mainstream valves, Wi-Fi fast distribution network with no additional gateway required, intelligent PID algorithm for efficient valve opening and closing, ultra-quiet motor technology and automatic summer/winter time conversion. It supports Smart Life app remote control and voice control.
keyFeatures: four time periods and setting temperature per day in Auto mode
Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant support
technicalData: Power supply: 3 x 1.5V alkaline AA batteries

trv-705wf.name: Thermostatic Radiator Valve
trv-705wf.description: TRV-705WF is a LED WiFi smart thermostat radiator valve. The guide states it supports 4 standard modes and up to 6 programs for 7 days a week and complies with CE conformity RED/LVD/EMC and RoHS conformity. The product page states it can work directly with Tuya Smart or Smart Life app without a Zigbee gateway and allows temperature and working mode setting on device or smartphone.
keyFeatures: LED WiFi smart thermostat radiator valve

cct-28-x.name: Hub Controller
cct-28-x.description: CCT-28-X Wireless Hub Controller is used in water underfloor heating systems. The manual states it can control zone valves or boiler thermostats and, as a central control unit, can control boiler and circulating pump. According to the user set temperature, it controls opening or closing boiler, circulating pump and electric actuators to achieve comfort and energy consumption saving.
keyFeatures: central control for boiler, circulating pump, electric actuators and thermostats
time delay function for boiler/pump protection
technicalData: current loading: max 20mA in manual, 10A on product page
pump output delay: 5 min in manual

bot-r7x-wifi-nr.name: Gas Boiler Thermostat
bot-r7x-wifi-nr.description: The manual for the wireless BOT-R7X thermostat describes an intelligent digital thermostat used as a temperature controller. The device compares the current room temperature with the setpoint and controls the water valves of a hydronic underfloor heating system. The BOT-R7X-WIFI-NR model specifies no receiver and operates as a standalone WiFi thermostat. It is compatible with the CCT-28-X hub controller, allowing integration into centralized heating management systems. The WiFi version supports remote control via a mobile application. The thermostat controls water heating circuits through its built-in relay and is suitable for manifolds with electro-thermal actuators.
keyFeatures: mode switching between manual and automatic modes
IP20. The invoice additionally specifies no receiver and compatibility with CCT-28-X hub controller.
technicalData: WiFi connection steps through Tuya app
K1/K2 passive linkage of wall-hung furnaces in R7X source.

rz-d01-230-nc.name: Thermal Actuator
rz-d01-230-nc.description: RZ-D01-230-NC is a normally closed electrical thermal actuator valve for water floor heating systems. The product description states it integrates manual and automatic control functions, with manual operation and automatic control modes. It is used for controlling manifolds, water valves and similar water underfloor heating components.
keyFeatures: used to control manifolds and water valves.
